title: 'ticfac' with no arguments: every run, attention first, and every stop says how to clear it
description: The overview: every run this machine knows (local runs and the factory's cloud runs), attention first. A run held for a person shows the reason in one line and the single command that clears it (e.g. 'ticfac triage gvc', 'ticfac run gvc' to resume after a fix). Built on the 6dh status model; renders like 89m but across runs.
notes: 2026-09-27 09:45 - ticfac run epic-2jn: 2qz try 1 (run dispatch #10) merged into epic/2jn as 0f032673f2f6; the integrated gate (go, ts) passed.
acceptance_criteria: 'ticfac' lists local and cloud runs with attention first; every held or failed run names its reason and the one clearing command; --json emits the same model; a test covers held, failed, running and done runs
